summary: The first small real-data run on the native C++ engine succeeded on 28 September: four CPU updates using two public research scans and one held-out scan, with checkpoint save/resume. The latest native build passes 51 tests. Held-out patch Dice did not improve, so useful masking quality is not yet demonstrated. GPU hardware verification and broader training are next.
